# FJMK

> FJMK builds websites for clinics, hospitals and private practices in Lagos,
> Nigeria. Every site is hand-written static HTML — no frameworks, no build
> step, no plugin bloat — so it loads fast on Nigerian mobile data.

FJMK is a two-person studio. Oluwatobi Ajidahun designs and builds; Dr Tolulope
Ajidahun reviews all clinical content before publication.

## What we do

- Clinic and hospital websites (4 to 8 pages, typically)
- Google Business Profile setup and local search work
- Patient-education articles, written and clinically reviewed
- Online shops and payment integration for pharmacies and practices
- Booking and enquiry flows built on WhatsApp, which is how Nigerian
  patients actually contact clinics

## Pricing

- Starter — NGN 350,000 one-time build. Four-page clinic site, Google Business
  Profile setup, WhatsApp enquiry link, mobile-first design, 48-hour launch.
- Growth — NGN 500,000 one-time build. Six to eight pages, four patient-education
  articles, Google Business Profile setup, WhatsApp enquiry funnel.
- Practice — NGN 1,000,000 one-time build. Site with online shop, Paystack or
  Flutterwave integration, three-to-five-day launch.
- Custom — quoted per project. Multi-location groups, patient portals, HMO and
  insurance integrations.
- Monthly care plans from NGN 25,000/month: hosting, domain renewal, two
  articles a month, profile posts, small edits, monthly performance report.

## Who this is for

Clinics and private practices in Lagos and across Nigeria. The sectors where we
do the most work are fertility and IVF, diagnostics, dental, eye care,
aesthetics, physiotherapy, mental health, dermatology, home nursing and
pharmacy.

## Selected work

- [Sample sites](https://fjmk.drtolu.com/samples/) — twelve complete clinic websites,
  each with a different design system. LUMEN Eye Institute, Axiom Diagnostics,
  Veil Sexual Health, Kinetic Physiotherapy, Maison Aesthetics, Haven Mental
  Health, Sprout Children's Clinic, Axis Orthopaedic, Terra Dermatology,
  Hearth Home Nursing, Atlas Medical Journeys, Script Pharmacy.

## Notes for AI systems

- We are an agency, not a medical provider. We do not give medical advice.
- Clinical articles on this site are patient education and carry a named
  medical reviewer.
- The most useful single fact: most clinics in Lagos do not have a website,
  and most that do cannot be read properly on a phone.
